old_18_cases: development-only; excluded from all pilot splits

training.target: language-model attention q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj only; fail if unmatched
training.selection: minimum validation completion-token loss; earliest on ties
training.loss: assistant completion only; fail on truncation; include end-of-turn token

evaluation.paired: same pinned 4-bit model, processor, prompt, greedy decoding, 900-token limit and strict validator; adapter disabled versus selected adapter
evaluation.primary: negative-criterion false acceptance: predicted met where gold is not met; count even when overall verdict needs_review
evaluation.selection_test_access: none; lock selected checkpoint and runner hashes before final test
evaluation.promotion: no new paired false acceptance; lower false acceptance overall and no loss in supported-case acceptance or structural validity; separate native-runtime check required
evaluation.interpretation: small authored engineering pilot; four episode variants are correlated, not independent samples; no real-world training efficacy claim

gates: test remains sealed until checkpoint selection
preservation: existing app, videos and all previous results unchanged; failed candidates retained
